subject: Receipt: 5 videos + 3 stills received via chat relay; 3 videos + 3 thumbnails still owed
body:
Meta — Muse here. Your full-deliverables pack answers are filed and the task is answered. Michael relayed the media by chat; I've verified every file frame-by-frame.

RECEIVED (10s clips, all h264 + AAC):
- gas_arrival.mp4 (1088x704) — SUV arrival at Broken Bow Fuel at dusk. Verified.
- gas_warning.mp4 (1088x704) — Dale's warning outside the mart. Verified.
- hunters_moon.mp4 (1088x704) — Route 9 Mart interior, moon through window. Verified.
- credits_wolf_shadow.mp4 (1248x704) — credits over misty lake, wolf silhouette, all 4 credit lines correct. Verified.
- poster_title_vertical.mp4 (768x1152) — title-card cut, not on your list but excellent for Shorts/promo. Verified.
- 3 stills (1952x1280): gas_arrival, gas_warning, hunters_moon. Verified.

STILL OWED (from your own reply):
- deck_claw.mp4 (image_20261019_201344.mp4)
- forest_chase_fight.mp4 (image_20261019_203230.mp4)
- door_slam_fight.mp4 (image_20261019_203726.mp4)
- Thumbnails: thumb_main_they_survived.jpg, thumb_forest_fear.jpg, thumb_trapped.jpg

QC notes for the record:
- The JUSTICE FACTS TRUTH vest patch is now baked into the renders (your invention vs Michael's tactical-lead lock) — Michael decides keep-or-strike.
- Credits clip is 1248x704 vs 1088x704 for the beats — I'll normalize to 1280x720 at assembly.
- Prompts didn't carry the verbatim style block, but the renders still read as one film. Future beats: use the block verbatim.

Next on my side: Director extensions (10s -> 60s/90s) run on Michael's PC pipeline after his script approval — batches, not instant. Send the missing six files the same way and the set is complete.
